I don’t think a Google review can fully capture what Kesha has been for me.

Back in September 2025, I had one of the worst anxiety attacks of my life. It was a Sunday, and I remember calling multiple therapists, but no one was available. In complete panic, I found Kesha’s number on Google and called her, barely able to speak through my tears, just saying I needed help.

What she did next is something I will never forget. Without hesitation, on a Sunday night, and despite not feeling well herself, she opened her clinic just to see me. She sat with me, calmed me down, and helped me get through that moment.

Over the following weeks and months, I continued to struggle with anxiety attacks, but she was always there. Whether it was picking up my calls, calming me over video calls, or guiding me through sessions, she showed up every single time with patience, warmth, and genuine care.

Therapy with her has never felt clinical or distant. It’s been safe, peaceful, and deeply comforting. She listens without judgment, understands without needing too many words, and helps you feel grounded even on your worst days.

I truly feel lucky to have found her when I did. For me, she wasn’t just a therapist in that moment, she was exactly the support I needed when everything felt overwhelming.

If you’re looking for someone who is not just professional but also incredibly compassionate and dependable, I cannot recommend Kesha enough. <3
